value: Permits are split between DOB NOW (most current permits) and BIS (older jobs); search both before concluding a permit is missing.
NYC Open Data publishes BIS permits and DOB NOW permits as separate datasets.
BIS and DOB NOW accept connections only from inside the United States.

If the building is a designated landmark or in a historic district, the Landmarks Preservation Commission keeps a separate permit record: its online permit search covers applications from January 1, 2016; older ones need a Records Access Request.
